jobs.title: Head of Workforce Planning & Go-to-Market Strategy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.

Position Overview

We are looking for a visionary Head of Planning to own our global Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and lead our Workforce Planning business. In this role, you will bridge the gap between the Visier solution and influencing our customer strategic workforce plans. You will be responsible for defining how Visier builds and scales its planning solutions in the market, driving revenue growth, and leading the workforce planning consulting team that helps enterprise customers transition from static plans to living, continuous workforce strategies. If you are a strategic leader with a strong POV on strategic workforce planning (SWP), enterprise change management, and scaling Strategic Workforce Planning GTM functions, this is your opportunity to shape the industry standard.


What You Will Deliver:

Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy & Market Ownership

  • Own the GTM Strategy: Define, execute, and evolve the global market strategy for Visier’s Workforce Planning solutions including driving pipeline, adoption, and revenue growth.

  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Solutions and Success to ensure Visier Workforce Planning aligns with market demand and customer demand.

Team Leadership & Practice Excellence

  • Lead the Advisory Function: Manage, mentor, and scale a team of  Workforce Planning Advisory Consultants who deliver end-to-end strategic programs for enterprise customers.

  • Set the Standard: Establish and continuously optimize the consulting methodology, standards, and best practices for customer engagements (including process mapping, workshops, and change management).

  • Operational Governance: Oversee cross-organizational collaboration (Project Managers, Data/BI Consultants, Development, and Support) to ensure successful implementations leading to customer success and retention.

Customer Success & Executive Sponsorship

  • Executive Advocacy: Serve as the executive face of critical customer engagements, setting expectations, aligning stakeholders, and building lasting relationships with C-suite and HR/Finance executives.

  • Champion the Customer Voice: Channel field insights, customer feedback, and domain knowledge back into the Product and Development teams to continuously enrich Visier’s technology.

What You Will Bring To The Table:

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience leading Workforce Planning, management consulting, or enterprise software delivery within the HR tech, Finance, or Workforce Planning domains.

  • Leadership Background: Proven track record of managing and scaling a software and/or services business catering to large enterprises (5,000+ employees).

  • Domain Expertise: A strong point of view on modern Strategic Workforce Planning (SWP) practices, financial/workforce model behavior, and talent analytics.

  • Future Looking: Deep understanding of workforce transformation initiatives, specifically around how AI, automation, skills-gap analysis, and job redesign impact organizational design.

  • Change Management : Strong ability to guide enterprise clients through the changes required to move from static planning to a distributed, continuous planning environment.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial and technical concepts beautifully to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to support global initiatives and key customer accounts (primarily Europe and North America).

Most Importantly, You Share Our Values:

  • You roll up your sleeves

  • You make it easy

  • You are proud

  • You never stop learning

  • You play to win

How We Work & What We Offer:

  • Annual company All Hands in Vancouver, our entire organization travels to our Vancouver HQ for a week of team building, learning and breakout sessions

  • Competitive salary, and top-tier health and wellness benefits

  • Stock options and/or bonus based on your role, location, and employment type

  • Generous paid time off and extra days over the December holidays

 

Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional compensation such as commission or bonus plans. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk through the details if you interview for the role.

AI in Hiring
As a people analytics company, we think carefully about how AI is used in decisions that affect people, including our own. Our Talent Acquisition team uses AI tools to help review resumes and application responses, so every candidate's application is assessed quickly and consistently against the role's requirements. AI may also assist with scheduling and summarizing interview notes. These tools support our team; they don't replace it. Every hiring decision at Visier is made by a person, not an algorithm.


How you prepare is up to you, and there's no issue with using AI as a helpful tool along the way. What matters most to us is that what you share, whether in your application or in conversation with us, reflects your own real experience and skills. We ask that live interviews be AI-free, so we can get to know how you communicate, think through problems, and describe the work you've actually done. We reserve the right to end the interview early if candidate fraud is suspected.


If you have questions about how AI is used in our process or how your data is handled, review our Visier Candidate Privacy Notice or reach out to us.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Embedded Analytics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.


Position Overview

As an Account Executive for our Embedded team, you will own the end-to-end sales process for new logo-based clients in North America, acting as a crucial driver in an outcomes-based selling motion. 

Visier provides foundational technology for our embedded partners to commercialize workforce data, accelerate AI innovation and unlock valuable insight using a purpose-built context layer. 

You will leverage advanced relationship building and strategic communication skills, paired with knowledge of modern GTM practices, to generate a consistent pipeline, influence executive stakeholders, secure new embedded partners and drive revenue growth. 

Through this work you’ll enable our partners to drive value for their customers and realize quantifiable outcomes while helping Visier achieve sales objectives in the North America region for our embedded products.


What You Will Deliver:

  • Pipeline Development & Control: Own and control the sales process for Visier’s embedded solutions across key verticals, consistently achieving annual sales quotas based on annual contract value.

  • Outcomes-Based Alignment: Utilize effective research and sales discovery techniques to identify a prospect’s strategic priorities, tying Visier's value directly to their desired outcomes.

  • Strategic GTM Guidance: Recommend and guide packaging decisions and go-to-market strategies for each partner’s embedded implementation to ensure optimal value realization.

  • Commercial Creativity: Strategically address financial objections and blockers by reframing current ways of thinking about budget, cost of inaction, and build vs. buy considerations. 

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proactively partner with internal Visier teams and stakeholders to establish credibility, develop compelling business cases, and ultimately deliver on our partnership commitments. 

What You’ll Bring to the Table:

  • Education & Experience: 7+ years of established success selling complex cloud-based solutions (Embedded/OEM or PaaS preferred).

  • Outcomes-Based Sales Mastery: Mastery of foundational sales skills (MEDDPICC or MEDDIC) combined with a strategic understanding of complex business challenges to close strategic accounts.

  • Creative Conflict & Communication: The ability to share your unique perspective, openly debate ideas to find the best solutions, and authentically engage with C-level executives.

  • Drive to Win: A goal-focused mentality where you take smart risks, move fast, and stay hungry to win as a team.

  • Independent Execution: Proven ability to work independently, receiving little instruction on day-to-day work, while selecting the best methods and techniques for closing customer deals.

  • Learning Agility: A continuous learning mindset where if you don't get it right the first time, you learn and try again.

What We Value:

  • You roll up your sleeves

  • You make it easy

  • You are proud

  • You never stop learning

  • You play to win

How We Work and What We Offer:

  • Annual company All Hands in Vancouver, our entire organization travels to our Vancouver HQ for a week of team building, learning and breakout sessions

  • Competitive salary, and top-tier health and wellness benefits

  • Stock options and/or bonus based on your role, location, and employment type

The base pay range for this position in the US is $140,000 - $150,000 USD/year + bonus

Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. jobs.title: Software Developer Intern (January to June 2027)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.

Position Overview

Visier is recruiting for a Software Developer Intern to join our innovative and extremely talented Development department.

Our internship experience is unique and designed to prepare you for professional success as you work on real, impactful work from the beginning...not features that may be mothballed after a few months of hard work! Our ultimate goal is to give you the mentorship, training, and work experience you need to start your career. A number of our students return to us after they graduate and start developing their professional career at Visier!

And we use cool state-of-the-art technology to build our innovative full-stack software solution that helps people see the truth and drives organizations to perform their best. We use a variety of frontend technologies including Angular, React, NgRx, Play Framework, TypeScript, Less, and others. We deal with large volumes of data every day. And in our backend areas we work with technologies like Scala, Kotlin, Python, Kafka, Spark, Consul, Cassandra DB, Docker, AWS, etc. We work with LLMs, various prompt engineering techniques and related technologies such as LangChain. So, you’ll be developing knowledge and skills that are transferable anywhere.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Writing production level code that will directly impact customers

  • Implementing cool new features

  • Fixing complex bugs

  • Writing tests

  • Collaborating with people in all stages of the software development cycle

 

What you'll bring to the table

  • Coding skills in relevant programming languages (for example, like Java, Python, JavaScript, Typescript, Scala, or other similar languages)

  • Knowledge of data structures and algorithms

  • Knowledge of one of the following areas would be an advantage:

    • LLMs

    • Web technologies (REST, HTML/CSS, JSON, Angular)

    • Relational and non-relational databases and SQL language

  • Coding skills in writing functional tests

  • Attention to detail, tendency to spot mistakes and identify potential improvements

Most importantly, you share our values

  • You roll up your sleeves

  • You make it easy

  • You are proud

  • You never stop learning

  • You play to win

Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional compensation such as commission or bonus plans. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk through the details if you interview for the role.

Our Talent Acquisition team uses AI tools to help review resumes and application responses, so every candidate's application is assessed quickly and consistently against the role's requirements. AI may also assist with scheduling and summarizing interview notes. These tools support our team; they don't replace it. Every hiring decision at Visier is made by a person, not an algorithm.


How you prepare is up to you, and there's no issue with using AI as a helpful tool along the way. What matters most to us is that what you share, whether in your application or in conversation with us, reflects your own real experience and skills.
